text.en: A finding from a psychology study automatically applies to people in general, regardless of who was actually studied -- in reality, a large share of historical psychological research sampled WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, Democratic) populations almost exclusively, which are demographically unusual on a global scale, so a finding's generalizability to other populations is a real, separate question that has to be checked, not assumed.
text.et: Psühholoogiauuringu leid kehtib automaatselt inimeste kohta üldiselt, sõltumata sellest, keda tegelikult uuriti -- tegelikult tugines suur osa ajaloolisest psühholoogiauuringust peaaegu eranditult WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, Democratic) populatsioonidele, mis on globaalses mastaabis demograafiliselt ebatavalised, mistõttu leiu üldistatavus teistele populatsioonidele on tõeline, eraldiseisev küsimus, mida tuleb kontrollida, mitte eeldada.
